_comment: Inventory item recipes. An item is a SMALL COMPONENT: its own matter (composition), its own form (footprint/volume), and its own pre-installed organs — it is never merged into the host on equip, so using a knife degrades the knife, not the hand. Its stats derive from its own recipe exactly as a component's do: existence, the six channel resistances, mass, and (for the knife) a depletable sharpness from the edge material. A knife carries no organ because sharpness is a matter-derived edge quality, not a function stat.
